newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Ill. Quad 2 nuke further cuts output.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Ill. Quad 2 nuke further cuts output.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) continued to cut power output at its 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities 2 nuclear power station and might have to fully shut it for repairs, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday.
The plant, in Cordova, Ill., was operating at 14 percent of its rated capacity early Tuesday, a further reduction from its 42 percent output level early Monday, the NRC said.
The NRC said "leak testing (was) in progress to determine either power ascension or unit shutdown for repairs."
The problem stems from a packing leak on a containment valve used in the unit's reactor water cleanup system.
Company officials could not be immediately reached for comment.
The commission reported the neighboring unit, Quad Cities 1, also rated at 789 MW, was operating at full capacity.
Commonwealth Edison is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
